title: List groups a user belongs to
summary: Show which groups the current user or a specific user is a member of. This helps verify permissions or troubleshoot access issues.

steps.explain: Run the command without arguments to see the groups for the currently logged-in user.
steps.expect: A space-separated list of group names (e.g., 'user sudo audio').

alternatives.explain: Run id with a username to display that user's UID, GID, and group memberships.
alternatives.expect: Output showing uid, gid, and groups for the specified user

steps.explain: To check groups for a different user, provide their username as an argument.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the user whose groups you want to list.

steps.expect: A space-separated list of group names for the specified user.
